title: Triad Test Stencil
content: On ourFacebook group "Color in Practice,"Ryan Cokercame up with a great solution for drawing the grids for the Triad Tests.He says: "I used my 3D printer/software to create/build a Triad Maker Stencil. Two are shown here in black and clear. And to the left (top), I connected the lines using the straight edge on the outside of the stencil."You can also draw them with a30/60/90 triangle, or just freehand them.Tutorial video:Triads: Painting with Three ColorsFacebook group "Color in Practice30/60/90 Triangle
